title: Press-Break Sideline Overload
description: Against a trap-heavy press, the offense overloads one sideline with multiple outlets, giving the ball handler several safe release options.

content.objective: Create multiple safe outlets along one sideline so a trap always has somewhere to release the ball.
content.setup: The offense sets up with three players stacked at different heights along one sideline against full-court pressure.
instructions: The ball handler attacks the sideline where the overload is set.
If trapped, the ball handler passes to the nearest safe outlet, never forcing it across the court.
The receiving player immediately looks to advance the ball up the same sideline.
Reset with the overload set up on the opposite sideline.
coachingPoints: Keep outlets at different distances so there's always a short, safe pass available.
Never force a long cross-court pass under trap pressure.
Advance the ball quickly once past the trap, don't stop and admire it.
commonMistakes: Forcing a risky pass across the court instead of using the nearest outlet.
Outlets standing too close together, letting one defender cover two of them.
Standing still instead of working to get open against the pressure.
content.safety: Run the press at a controlled intensity so traps don't become reckless contact.
